PreToolUse.description: Block a specific set of dangerous git operations (force flags, hard resets, branch/commit switching), except inside an agent-owned worktree (.agents/worktrees/<name>); push is blocked except the one canonical `git push -u origin HEAD:<branch>` form.
Block bare grep/egrep/fgrep search invocations; require rg (ripgrep) instead. grep piped after another command to filter its output stays allowed.
Block shell commands that would put more than 120 lines of a file into an agent's context in one unfiltered read. A cost guard, not a security boundary; fails open rather than costing a wasted turn.
Block direct file-edit writes anywhere inside git's administrative area, the per-user git configuration, and plan-run authorization records under docs/runs/plan-runs/. Fails closed.

Block shell-issued writes (redirects, tee, sed -i, cp/mv/ln, rm, curl -o, ...) whose target resolves into git's administrative area or a plan-run authorization record. Interpreter-mediated writes are deliberately NOT closed.
Block un-consented agent-memory writes to ~/.claude/**/memory/ and .remember/; memories must be recorded deliberately in tracked repo files after the user explicitly agrees.

Enforce code-review-fix-loop's --max-iterations default of 5 by denying the sixth dispatch of its always-on first dimension (code-reviewer) within one session. A 20-minute idle gap starts a fresh run.

UserPromptSubmit.description: Re-inject the canonical response-shaping contract on every user turn. Deliberately not silenced: a silently-failing hook is invisible from the agent's behavior alone.

SessionStart.description: Re-inject the response-shaping contract after a context compaction, which does not preserve hook stdout.

SubagentStart.description: Inject the 'Not covered' handback contract into every read-only subagent type (the set is owned by READ_ONLY_AGENT_TYPES in agentic_workflows/agent_handback_contract.py), so an agent that stops early says what it did not reach. Context-only: it cannot change the subagent's model, tools, or prompt.

InstructionsLoaded.description: Append every instruction-file load to logs/instructions_loaded.jsonl with its load_reason. Observational only — cannot filter or block a rule from loading.
